encounter: E0012 TRAINER_WINSTON_1; playtest rerun R1, cap 14, attempt 1
availability_audit: CHRONOLOGY-LEGAL FOR NORTH ROUTE 104. This battle campaign_order 12 sits after the Petalburg Woods encounters (campaign_order 9-11) on the Rustboro side of Route 104, so both Route104 and PetalburgWoods tables are legal. HERACROSS = wild:PetalburgWoods/land_mons; CROAGUNK = wild:Route104/land_mons; GROWLITHE, ROCKRUFF = wild:Route103/land_mons; TIMBURR, PACHIRISU = wild:Route102/land_mons. Nothing evolved (Rustboro is still ahead), nothing fished, no legendary/mythical/Ultra Beast/Paradox species.
plan: Winston answers to the crack list almost exactly. Taunt: TIMBURR carries it and, being slow, is also a Trick Room beneficiary if the room does go up. Double targeting Porygon: Heracross and Growlithe both hit Normal for 2x with Close Combat. Priority: Timburr Mach Punch, Rockruff Sucker Punch, Croagunk Fake Out - and Fake Out on the setter is the cheapest Trick Room denial there is. Type coverage for the odd defensive spread: Honedge and Gimmighoul are immune to Normal and Fighting, so Growlithe FLARE_BLITZ (2x on Steel/Ghost) and the Dark lanes (Heracross and Timburr Knock Off, Rockruff Crunch/Sucker Punch) are the answers to those two, while Fighting covers Porygon and Wooloo.
